name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Third-party (TranscriptAPI) REST API and hosted MCP server returning YouTube transcripts, search, channel and playlist data.
auth_notes: Bearer API key in Authorization header from dashboard. MCP also supports OAuth 2.1. No Google API key.
access_notes: Self-serve signup; new accounts get 100 free credits; paid plans for more credits.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve key, 13 documented REST endpoints with Bearer auth and per-account rate limits. Third-party scraper of YouTube; terms and reliability need review.

needs_human_reason: Third-party service not affiliated with YouTube; legal/terms review needed.

disputes.why: Vendor docs state a hosted MCP server at transcriptapi.com/mcp with 12 tools, same keys and credits.
Vendor API reference endpoint table lists 13 endpoints.
Channel videos, playlists and playlist videos are listed as paginated endpoints.

auth.quote: The API uses Bearer token authentication.

api_surface.quote: The limit applies **per account**: all API keys on your account share it.

mcp.quote: TranscriptAPI runs a hosted (remote) MCP server at https://transcriptapi.com/mcp.

identity.quote: Extract YouTube video transcripts with a simple API call or through Model Context Protocol
